instruction: Enable Windows Filter Keys and keep them enabled. Add the products and quantities listed in the provided `ShoppingList.ods` on Desktop to the OneStopMarket cart, with no additional products.
gt_steps: Keep Filter Keys enabled throughout the task.
Review the product names and required quantities in the Shopping List sheet.
Open the self-hosted OneStopMarket website in Google Chrome.
Search for `Mexican Cola Soda 4 Pack 500ml Glass Bottles Coca-Cola`.
Add 1 unit of the Mexican Cola Soda product to the shopping cart.
Add 3 units of the Chippies Banana Chips product to the shopping cart.
Search for `Dove Intense Nourishment Body Lotion 250ml`.
Add 1 unit of the Dove body lotion product to the shopping cart.
Search for `Nature Republic California Aloe Vera Cleansing Tissue 1 Pack (80 Sheets)`.
Add 2 units of the Nature Republic cleansing tissue product to the shopping cart.
Search for `PAM Spray Pump Olive Oil Cooking Spray, Keto Friendly, 7 oz.`.
Add 1 unit of the PAM olive oil cooking spray to the shopping cart.
Verify that the cart contains only the five listed products.
Verify that each product has the required quantity.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$src='using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public class FK { [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct FILTERKEYS { public uint cbSize; public uint dwFlags; public uint iWaitMSec; public uint iDelayMSec; public uint iRepeatMSec; public uint iBounceMSec; } [DllImport(\"user32.dll\", SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(uint uiAction, uint uiParam, ref FILTERKEYS pvParam, uint fWinIni); }'; Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src; $fk=New-Object FK+FILTERKEYS; $fk.cbSize=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SizeOf($fk); $ok=[FK]::SystemParametersInfo(0x0032,$fk.cbSize,[ref]$fk,0); if ($ok -and (($fk.dwFlags -band 0x1) -ne 0)) { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
